def factor_volume_beta_tail_gated(df):
    """Crash-predictor liquidity beta scaled by tail fragility intensity."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_vol = np.log(df_copy["volume"].clip(lower=1.0))
    vol_change = log_vol.diff()
    window = 20
    cov = ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).cov(vol_change)
    var_vol = vol_change.rolling(window, min_periods=window).var(ddof=1)
    beta = cov / var_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    downside_ret = ret.clip(upper=0.0)
    downside_var = downside_ret.pow(2).rolling(60, min_periods=60).sum()
    total_var = ret.pow(2).rolling(60, min_periods=60).sum()
    downside_ratio = downside_var / total_var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    downside_ratio = downside_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    weight = 0.5 + 0.5 * downside_ratio.fillna(0.5)
    factor = -beta * weight
    factor.name = "factor_volume_beta_tail_gated"
    return factor
description: Primary mechanism is the crash-predictor volume-return liquidity beta: negative beta indicates distributional selling pressure and is negated so higher values signal fragility. Secondary parent contributes a lightweight downside variance ratio, which measures the proportion of 60-day squared returns from negative days. We use this ratio as a bounded scaling weight (0.5 to 1.0) to amplify the liquidity-beta signal when recent downside concentration is high and attenuate it when the distribution is balanced. This preserves the raw single-stock mechanism without cross-sectional transformation, targeting IC improvement via tail-state conditioning while retaining the parent RankICIR and payoff strength.
